results.title: India Poised To Become Space Powerhouse As Australia Deepens Cooperation
results.description: Former Australian Prime Minister Scott Morrison has expressed strong confidence in India’s future as a global leader in space technology. Speaking virtually at the Indo-Mediterranean Dialogues, he said India has the potential to become a “space powerhouse” within the next two to three decades, citing its favourable geography, industrial capabilities and expanding technological base.Morrison

results.title: Reliance Joins Hands With Rolls-Royce for India's Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft: Report
results.description: The Indian Air Force endeavors to do away with overreliance on the gate-kept Rafael and aging Sukhois. Will the RIL-Rolls-Royce strategic parentship produce an indigenous engine to bridge the gap eight decades after the independence?
